USCIS Exam Guides book companions

General information only. Not legal advice. Not medical advice. Not affiliated with USCIS.

Which book are you reading?

Each USCIS Exam Guides Kindle book prints a link to one page here. That page gives the next step that goes with the book. For the immigration medical exam, that step is a free callback from a civil surgeon near you, or the official USCIS civil surgeon finder. Pick your book below.

Book companion pages

  • The Naturalization Interview & Immigration Medical Exam Guide: find a USCIS-designated civil surgeon and prepare for the interview

Free guides

Every guide on this site is free to read: all USCIS medical exam guides.
